title: Trade US Stocks on Delta Exchange India with RWA Tokens
summary: Trade NVIDIA, Tesla and Apple-linked perpetuals on Delta Exchange India. Learn how RWA tokens work and how to backtest, paper trade and automate them on AlgoTest.
body_markdown:
RWA tokens on Delta Exchange India are perpetual futures contracts that track the price of real-world assets, such as shares of US companies. They let you trade price moves in NVIDIA, Tesla, Apple or Amazon from your Delta Exchange account, without opening a US brokerage account.


[AlgoTest](https://algotest.in/register?utm_source=blogs&utm_medium=organics&utm_campaign=seo&utm_source=blogs&utm_medium=organics&utm_campaign=seo) now supports all 31 stock tokens listed on Delta Exchange India. You can backtest them, replay past sessions, paper trade and automate live execution from one place.


Here’s how RWA trading on Delta Exchange works and how to test a strategy before you go live.


## What Are RWA Tokens on Delta Exchange India?


An **RWA (Real-World Asset) token** is a crypto token designed to track the price of an asset outside crypto, such as a company’s shares.


On Delta Exchange India, you trade these tokens as perpetual futures, quoted in USD. For example, the NVIDIA-linked perpetual (NVDAXUSD) moves with the price of NVIDIA stock.


A perpetual future is a futures contract with no expiry date. You can hold a position for as long as you like, with no rollover.


**Trading an RWA perpetual is not the same as buying the stock.** Keep these points in mind:


-


You can go long or short based on your market view.


-


You do not get ownership, dividends or voting rights in the company.


-


Leverage, funding payments and liquidation risk apply.


-


These contracts can trade outside[regular US market hours.](https://algotest.in/blog/us-market-opening-time-in-india/)


## Can You Trade US Stocks on Delta Exchange?


Yes. Delta Exchange India lists perpetual futures linked to major US stocks and ETFs, including NVIDIA, Tesla, Apple, Amazon, Alphabet and Meta.


You are trading the price movement, not buying shares. This makes RWA perpetuals a short-term trading tool, not a long-term investment.


If your goal is to own US shares for the long run, a broker that offers direct US stock investing is the better route. Compare your options in our guide to the[best Indian brokers to invest in US stocks](https://algotest.in/blog/best-brokers-to-invest-in-us-stocks-from-india/) .

## How to Trade and Backtest RWA Tokens on AlgoTest


RWA tokens work just like BTCUSD and ETHUSD on[AlgoTest](https://ttps//algotest.in/register?utm_source=blogs&utm_medium=organics&utm_campaign=seo&utm_source=blogs&utm_medium=organics&utm_campaign=seo) . You pick them in the same instrument selectors, use the same Delta Exchange account and trade them in the same hours.


Here’s what you can do with them across AlgoTest’s tools.


### 1. Backtest RWA Strategies on Historical Data


Before you trade NVIDIA or Tesla perpetuals live, check how your rules would have performed in the past.


AlgoTest’s[920 strategies](https://algotest.in/blog/the-920-straddle-strategy-defined) (Simple and Straddle) let you build, backtest, forward test and algo trade RWA tokens. To run a backtest:


1.


Open[AlgoTest Backtest](https://algotest.in/feature/backtest) .


2.


Select **Delta Exchange** in the Backtest section.


3.


Search for an RWA symbol, such as NVDAXUSD or TSLAXUSD.


4.


Pick your strategy type: Intraday, BTST or Positional.


5.


Add a Perpetual Futures leg and set your entry, exit, stop-loss and other conditions.


6.


Run the backtest and review the results.


A backtest shows profit and loss, drawdowns, win and loss trades, and how the strategy behaves in different market conditions.


For example, instead of assuming that buying NVIDIA-linked futures at a set time is profitable, you can test that rule across all the historical data available for the contract.


*New to backtesting? Read our*[step-by-step guide to backtesting algo trading strategies](https://algotest.in/blog/how-to-backtest-algo-trading-strategies/) *.*

A backtest checks fixed rules automatically. The Simulator lets you replay a past session and take trades yourself.


With the[AlgoTest Simulator](https://algotest.in/feature/simulator?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=seo&utm_campaign=simulator&utm_source=blog&utm_medium=seo&utm_campaign=simulator) , you can:

This helps you understand how an instrument behaves during volatile sessions or outside US market hours.


See how AlgoTest’s Simulator compares with other tools in our[best options simulator in India](https://algotest.in/blog/best-options-simulator-india/) guide. For RWA tokens, the Simulator uses perpetual futures rather than options.


### 3. Paper Trade RWA Strategies Before Going Live


A strategy that worked on past data can behave differently in today’s market.


AlgoTest’s[paper trading](https://algotest.in/paper-trading) (Forward Testing) runs your strategy on live market data using simulated orders. For RWA perpetuals, you can:


-


Run your strategy without placing real orders.


-


Watch simulated entries and exits.


-


Track virtual profit and loss.


-


Compare forward-test results with your backtest.


For instance, suppose your Tesla-linked strategy enters on a momentum signal and exits at a stop-loss or target. You can forward test those rules without putting capital at risk.


Read more about how to[paper trade indicator-based algo strategies](https://algotest.in/blog/paper-trading-apps-for-indicator-algo-strategies-in-india/) .


Paper trading won’t remove live execution risks, but it can catch problems in your strategy logic before you deploy it.

### 7. Automate RWA Trades Through Delta Exchange


Once a strategy has passed backtesting and paper trading, you can consider live algo execution.


RWA orders go through your existing Delta Exchange connection, so there’s nothing extra to set up:


-

-


Execution settings, order types and deployment work exactly as they do for crypto.


-


There is no change to pricing or plans, so RWA tokens are available on the plan you already have.


If you’re new, connect your Delta Exchange India account to AlgoTest, save your RWA strategy, review position size and risk settings, and then deploy it.


Explore[crypto and RWA algo trading on AlgoTest](https://algotest.in/feature/crypto-trading) to see all the automation features.


Automation follows your rules exactly, but it cannot prevent market losses, slippage, API interruptions or liquidation.


## Delta Exchange RWA Trading Hours, Fees and Leverage


RWA tokens follow the same session as other Delta Exchange instruments on AlgoTest. Trading runs **23 hours a day, seven days a week** , with a daily break from **5:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST** .


This means you can trade US stock moves on weekends and outside regular US market hours.


Delta Exchange has cut maker and taker fees on US stock RWA tokens to 2 basis points. Funding payments and GST apply on top, so check the latest charges on Delta Exchange before you trade.


Delta Exchange lists up to 25x leverage on many US stock RWA perpetuals. Higher leverage increases both gains and losses, so set position size with care.


## Risks of Trading RWA Tokens on Delta Exchange


Keep these risks in mind before you trade:


-


The RWA contract price can drift away from the real stock price, especially when US markets are closed.


-


Long or short positions may pay or receive funding, which changes your final returns.


-


Leveraged positions can lose money quickly and may be liquidated.


-


Wide bid-ask spreads and thin order books can lead to poor fills.


-


Fees, funding and slippage can eat into your returns.


-


These contracts are not regulated as securities under Indian law, so they don’t carry the same protections as NSE or BSE products.


For full details, read[Delta Exchange’s RWA token derivatives disclaimer](https://www.delta.exchange/support/solutions?articleId=80001198376&categoryId=undefined&folderId=undefined) .

### FAQs


#### What are RWA tokens on Delta Exchange India?


An RWA token is a crypto token that tracks the price of an asset outside crypto, such as a company’s shares. On Delta Exchange India, you trade these tokens as perpetual futures quoted in USD.


#### Can I trade US stocks on Delta Exchange?


Yes. Delta Exchange India offers perpetual futures linked to US stocks such as NVIDIA, Tesla, Apple and Amazon. You trade the price movement, not the actual shares.


#### Do I own the shares when I trade RWA tokens?


No. RWA perpetuals are derivatives. You do not get ownership, dividends or voting rights in the company.


#### How many RWA tokens does AlgoTest support?


AlgoTest supports 31 stock tokens listed on Delta Exchange India, including NVDAXUSD, TSLAXUSD, AAPLXUSD, SPYXUSD and QQQXUSD. You can search for them by symbol in any instrument selector.


#### What is the difference between xStocks and bStocks on Delta Exchange?


Both are tokenized versions of US stocks, issued by different providers. Symbols ending in XUSD are xStock tokens, and symbols ending in BUSD are bStocks tokens. Both work the same way on AlgoTest.


#### What are the fees for US stock RWA tokens on Delta Exchange?


Delta Exchange charges 2 basis points for both maker and taker orders on US stock RWA tokens. Funding payments and GST are extra, so check current charges before trading.


#### What leverage does Delta Exchange offer on RWA tokens?


Delta Exchange lists up to 25x leverage on many US stock RWA perpetuals. Higher leverage raises the risk of large losses and liquidation.


#### Is Delta Exchange regulated in India?


Delta Exchange India is registered with FIU-IND. Its RWA token derivatives are not regulated as securities under Indian law, so they don’t carry the protections of NSE or BSE products.


#### Is RWA trading on Delta Exchange available 24/7?


Almost. On AlgoTest, RWA tokens trade 23 hours a day, seven days a week, with a daily break from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM IST.


#### Can I backtest RWA token strategies on AlgoTest?


Yes. You can backtest RWA tokens with 920 strategies and with Signals AI, using Perpetual Future data from Delta Exchange.


#### Can I paper trade RWA tokens on AlgoTest?


Yes. AlgoTest’s Forward Testing runs your RWA strategy on live market data with simulated orders, so no real capital is used.


#### Are RWA tokens available in the AlgoTest Simulator?


Yes. You can replay past Delta Exchange RWA sessions and take simulated trades in the AlgoTest Simulator.


#### Can I use TradingView alerts to trade RWA tokens?


Yes. Signals Classic lets you execute TradingView webhook signals on Delta Exchange RWA tokens.


#### Do I need a new plan or extra setup to trade RWA tokens on AlgoTest?


No. RWA orders go through your existing Delta Exchange connection, with no daily broker login. RWA tokens are available on the plans you already have.


#### Can I add RWA tokens to a watchlist in Signals AI?


Yes, but only to a Crypto watchlist, on their own or with BTCUSD and ETHUSD. A Crypto watchlist that includes an RWA token can only use Perpetual Future data. Indices and Stocks watchlists are for NSE and BSE instruments only.


#### Can I trade RWA token options on AlgoTest?


No. RWA tokens have no options contracts on Delta Exchange India, so Perpetual Future is the only data type available. Options, Combined Premium and Synthetic Future are not supported for RWA tokens.
